hero.proof: Factories in Bangladesh, Vietnam, India and Türkiye

how.title: From tech pack to delivery in three steps

request.title: Request a quote
request.body: Share your tech pack, quantities and target price. We route it to factories that fit your product and certifications.

compare.title: Compare and confirm
compare.body: Review anonymised offers side by side, approve samples, and pay a deposit into escrow when you’re ready.

track.title: Track to your door
track.body: Follow every milestone with photos, independent QC reports and shipping documents, all in one place.

trust.title: Built so you never have to take a factory’s word for it

verified.title: Verified factories
verified.body: Every manufacturer passes business and export checks, and their BSCI, WRAP, GOTS or OEKO-TEX certificates are verified before they can quote.

escrow.title: Escrow-protected payments
escrow.body: You pay GarmentGate, not the factory. Funds are released in stages as production milestones are approved.

qc.title: Independent QC inspection
qc.body: AQL inspections during and after production. Nothing ships until it passes, and you get the full report.

categories.title: Whatever you make, there’s a factory for it

cta.title: Ready to source with confidence?
cta.body: Create a free account in a minute. Our team will help you place your first order.

footer.tagline: Managed garment sourcing between global buyers and verified factories.

profile.title: Factory profile
profile.description: What buyers see when they find you, under your factory code only.

photos.title: Factory photos
photos.description: Show your floor, machines and finishing. Every photo is stripped of location and camera data, then checked by our team before buyers see it. Avoid signage, logos and faces.
photos.max: Up to {max} photos, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 15 MB each.
photos.emptyBody: Factories with photos get more quote requests. Add a few of your production floor.

certs.title: Certifications
certs.description: New certificates are verified by our team. Buyers see the standard you hold and its validity, never the certificate number.
certs.emptyBody: Add BSCI, WRAP, GOTS, OEKO-TEX or others to win buyers who require them.

preview.title: This is exactly what buyers see
preview.body: Generated by the same code that serves buyers. Your company name, address, website, contacts and certificate numbers are never included, and are removed from your own text too.
